data.name: Cross Electric
data.address: 9227 Live Oak Ln, Fort Worth, TX 76179

reviews.text: Mike did an excellent job. After having two other electricians not show up, it was refreshing to have someone arrive as promised. Mike took the time to explain everything in detail and addressed all my questions. He was professional, courteous, and completed the work promptly on the same day. I am extremely satisfied with the service provided by this company, and Crystal did a wonderful job of clarifying the entire process. I also found their pricing to be reasonable. I wholeheartedly recommend

I’ve had the opportunity to interact with several people from Cross Electric. This is a small business you can trust to always give you a professional assessment and a fair price. Their customer service is exceptional, they prioritize their customers and actually seem to care. Don’t waste your time and money on big companies where you are just another number.
Timely and professional service at a reasonable price.  Kerry was very personable and knowledgeable to work with during the RV receptacle install.  Much appreciated.

We have found our company and our electrician! Very prompt service and we felt a lot of confidence with Mike. He went over all our needs with us, fixed our current issues, installed surge protectors, and was friendly, polite and professional. We are excited for this new relationship in taking care of our home.  Highly recommend!

Crystal ,John and David were all awesome ! From when Crystal answered the phone and took down my information ( 11/26/25) to when John and David came out to assist me with my electrical issue, it was one of the best experiences all around. I can’t thank them enough. Highly recommend them !

Five Stars! Exceptional Electrician Service in Fort Worth!

I can't say enough good things about Cross Electric! From the initial phone call to the completed job, the experience was outstanding. The office staff was top-notch – kind, professional, and incredibly helpful. What really impressed me was their follow-up call to ensure we were completely satisfied with the service. In my experience with electricians, that level of care is rare and refreshing.

John, our electrician, was fantastic. He

Mike is AWESOME the entire staff is awesome.  He found the problem and diligently worked to get it fixed.  I can't say thank you enough.  I call 3 different places with only one talking to me but they were wishiey washey when they could get here.  Cross dispatcher listened and said.  "I'll get you someone as soon as he is done with the job he's on right now.". In 30 minutes maybe a hr.  Mike was at the door.   Thank you!

John came out and installed our RV Electrical box and explained everything in terms I could understand. He was very pleasant and did an awesome job. Thank you John and Cross Electric LLC for a job well done!

John and David, were prompt, kind and very professional. Explained what the solution was and the process to repair. Work was completed in a timely manner and they cleaned up after they finished. Will definitely reach out to Cross the next time we need electrical services in our home. Thanks!

Had John with Cross Electric come out to my new house and he did an amazing job! I would never use anyone else!! VERY knowledgeable, polite and did awesome work! Cross Electric has my business for life!
John was amazing! Helped us troubleshoot a couple issues after a serious storm. Took the time and went above and beyond normal service. Really appreciate the help!

Mike was amazing….very thorough with his analysis and explanation of what was required. Provided additional suggestion but not trying to “up sale”.  Very down to earth! Would be my go to any time I need an electrician!
David and John were awesome! Did great work in a timely manner and very pleasant to speak with. They were also great with our 2 dogs, which I always appreciate!

I've used Cross Electric multiple times ranging from very involved to straightforward jobs and they've been excellent every single time.  Prompt scheduling, always on-time, quality work and extremely polite technicians.  If I could rate 6-stars, I would.  Highly recommend.
John and Christian provided great service today!  From scheduling, to arriving, diagnosing my issues and the solution.   Cross Electric is our go to personally and for our business!

The work was completed today and everything went as well as expected,  crew was very nice and professional,  labeled everything properly and cleaned up after themselves. It was a scorching hot day and no complaints even though working in the attic was required.  Price was fair, work was great, no hesitation to use them again.
John and Cross Electric did a great job. He was very knowledgeable on what had previously been done and was super helpful in explaining exactly what he did and help get my charger setup!

Chris and Murphy were awesome. Very polite, fast and efficient. We discussed all the options and they explained everything before getting right to work. Their work was clean and neat. I only wish the office had explained all the fees to me when I made the appointment.

John did a fantastic job with the new line he had to run for an exterior outlet. The work was done quickly, neatly and he was honest and upfront throughout the whole process. We will absolutely be using him again!
Caleb was great! He arrived early, was knowledgeable and informative. He was also very patient answering all of my questions. Had a great experience and will definitely use Cross Electric again!
Wonderful job. Fixed everything and left my yard without any trash. Would recommend him 1000%

100% recommend Cross! They were able to get out to my house within 24hrs, were super great about communicating, and technician John was awesome, very friendly and quick. The price was fair and job was completed fast. Highly recommend Cross for any electric needs you may have!

John with Cross Electric was outstanding. His knowledge and work ethic and professionalism was something you rarely see these day. Spent the better part of a day with john as he upgraded my homes electrical service. Never had a uneasy feeling through the whole process. John and Cross Electric will be my go to
Kerry and his helper brought light to our church parking lot that has been dark for several years. It was a pleasure working with him.
Mike did a great job, going above and beyond to address our electrical issue and discuss concerns. Would definitely use this electrician again in the future.
Kerrie was on time, professional and extremely helpful. He was able to find the issue, explain to clearly, and fix it!

Caleb was professional, friendly, knowledgeable, on time & did a great job replacing my main breaker box panel today. He and the office staff alike, answered all my questions in a friendly manner. Best of all their price was reasonable & I will defiantly call them again next time I need any service.
Thank you Cross Electric for the great - fast service!
Ken

We had a light in the kitchen that made a popping noise and put off an odor, so we were alarmed. Crystal was so nice to get a tech dispatched within an hour of our call. Caleb arrived and was professional, knowledgeable and extremely nice! He fixed the problem quickly and he is coming back to install some lighting we have wanted to get refreshed for a long time! So excited to have found Cross Electric!!

Brandon captured our vision and Chris & Murphy delivered fantastic results for our outdoor lighting project. We originally wanted the up-lights in the front, replace the carriage lights, and add spotlights in the back yard.  Brandon pitched the idea of the Led down-lights in the soffit on the side and the back of the house instead of the spotlights. We are so glad we took Brandon’s recommendation.  The pictures speak for themselves.

Highly Recommend Cross Electric and can't wait to do the indoo
Friendly efficient scheduling and excellent service start to finish. Will definitely use again for electrical needs!

Caleb did a great job!  I have a big project Cross Electric had a cancellation so Caleb got a start on it during his cancelled appt.  Crystal in the office is amazing she listened and understood my needs and helped get us scheduled as soon as she has openings!  Cross Electric cares about their customers!!

Brandon with Cross Electric was very professional and thorough in providing solutions for a difficult situation. Brandon took his time walking the property and coming up with multiple solutions to choose from.

Chris B. and Chris M. Where the technicians that did the work for me. They were very professional and efficient. As a bonus, they were very patient, answering my dumb questions without throwing their tools at me.
Overall this repair work was accomplished within the estimated time and without issues. I will gladly recommend Cross to anyone needing electrical work.
John did an absolutely amazing job diagnosing my Tesla wall charger issue that 2 master electricians prior could not figure out. Customer for life now.
Great to work with! Excelent communication throughout the project! Guys were very friendly, professional and efficient.  Highly recommend!!

Great service and great install. My job was not an easy one but the guys worked hard to resolve my issues and get it done ASAP. I really appreciated the clear pricing and will definitely be using them again. Definitely will recommend them for an EV charger install as well. They did a great job there too

Thank you so very much Caleb for doing such a great job!!!!!  We were recommended to you by a friend and we're so thankful for the wonderful customer service, timeliness, cleanliness, and all the hard work today.  So thankful to FINALLY have a company we can trust and rely on.
John from Cross Electric did a great job. They were here on time. They worked all day, and I got what I expected.

Outstanding service! They handled a panel recall efficiently and even answered my general questions on a Saturday, completely outside normal hours. Friendly, responsive, and professional. Can’t recommend them enough!

John did an outstanding job installing my EV wall charger. He was professional, punctual, and incredibly knowledgeable about the process. He took the time to explain everything and ensured the installation was done safely and efficiently. The quality of his work was impeccable, and he left the area clean and tidy. I’m thrilled with the results and highly recommend John to anyone looking for a skilled electrician. He’s a true professional who goes above and beyond.

Kerrie did an amazing job! The issue ended up being on the Electricity provider side of things, but your team was quick to respond considering it was after hours, he was coming from far away (since locals didn't want to come until the next day).  While it ended up being really nothing for your team to do, I appreciate knowing that if needed, even after hours your company is willing to respond.  Your team pointed out things for me to consider in the future but it didn't feel high pressure.  Will

Caleb has done a lot of work at our home the last couple of weeks. He is very professional, patient, and just an all around good guy. He explained everything in detail so we could understand all the technical issues. He is always on time or early and stays til the job is done. He even cleans up before he leaves. We will never use another electrical company than Cross.

We had an electrical outlet installed outside of our 100 year old home. Caleb worked to find a solution to a very difficult task. He was professional, had a sense of humor, honest, mild mannered, and kept us updated on the project the entire time. Caleb took the time to make sure we were happy and it is clear he takes pride in his work and representation of Cross Electric. We look forward to doing more business with Caleb and Cross Electric in the future.
John and a colleague did a great job installing a Tesla wall charger going out of their way to install it on the preferred wall.
They responded the quickest and John came out same day and fixed the issue promptly. Thank you!!

John is smart ,polite,helpful,honest, and above all caring with alot of wisdom. We got hit by the storms and God sent us John.
Amen and Thank you

Caleb and Jonathan came ot the shop and quickly diagnosed the problem and had everything fixed and working again in short order.   I will be using them again to add in some new wiring for new shop equipment.  I highly recommend Cross Electric.  From Crystal to Caleb everyone I have dealt with has been great.

Well, we had a breaker box fire. And Cross Electric came quickly to the rescue. Brandon, John, and Jake were competent and efficient. My only problem is that the boxes are hard to open and all the breakers are not marked. BUT The main thing is that we have electricity in 100° weather!  Yay.

Kerrie and David did an amazing job for us. They got our pool lights and low voltage lights working again. They installed can lights in a difficult room with high ceiling and new task lighting in the main bathroom. They added whole house surge protection to both panels. And ... everything was done perfectly, cleanly, and efficiently. What's more, the price was very fair. I will always use Cross Electric from now on. And please send us Kerrie and David in a couple weeks for that outdoor lighting
John was awesome very knowledgeable and professional. Found and solved our problem within minutes of being here.
